description: Write stdin bytes to a running `command/exec` session, close stdin, or both.

closeStdin.description: Close input after queued bytes. Unix PTYs send canonical VEOF (including flushing a partial line); raw/disabled-VEOF terminals return an error. Terminal EOF is not a permanent pipe half-close.

deltaBase64.description: Optional base64-encoded stdin bytes to write.

processId.description: Client-supplied, connection-scoped `processId` from the original `command/exec` request.

title: CommandExecWriteParams
